Report Description///NEEC INCIDENT NOTIFICATION: CHLORINATED WATER SPILL TO WATER | FORT FRANCES WTP | RAINY RIVER, ON# 1-QNFGMY | FORT FRANCES WTP: OVERFLOW OF CHLORINATED WATER TO RAINY RIVER/// FORT FRANCES WTP: OVERFLOW OF CHLORINATED WATER TO RAINY RIVER DICHLORINATION SYSTEM RAINY RIVER TEMPORARY MEASURES INEFFECTIVE - CHLORINATED WATER DISCHARGE THAT EXCEED ACED THEIR WATER LICENCE ALLOWED CONCENTRATION COMMISSIONING THE A NEW CHLORINATION SYSTEM, PLACED SOME TEMPORARY DICHLORINATION PUCKS. USED, HOWEVER THE THE DICHLORINATION WAS NOT HAPPENING EFFICIENTLY ENOUGH. DISCHARGE OF CHLORINATED WATER FOR 3 HOURS FROM THEIR DICHLORINATION TANKS TO RAINY RIVER. CALLER DOES NOT KNOW HOW MUCH WATER HAS OVERFLOWN. NO VOLUME METER PRESENT AT DISCHARGE AREA. OVERFLOW BELIEVED TO HAVE HAPPENED BETWEEN 03:00 AND 06:00 TODAY. CAUSE OF OVERFLOW: SYSTEM AT CAPACITY, WATER WELLS DISCHARGED TO DICHLORINATION TANK, WHICH OVERFLOWED TO THE RIVER. CALLER EXPLAINS THAT DWS IS IN THE PROCESS OF COMMISSIONING A NEW DICHLORINATION SYSTEM FOR THE OVERFLOW BACKWASH WATER THAT USED TO GO STRAIGHT TO THE RIVER. TEMPORARY MEASURES INCLUDED TO ADD DICHLORINATION PUCKS AT DICHLORINATION TANK, HOWEVER, RECENTLY THEY FOUND OUT THE MEASURE WAS INEFFECTIVE. CHLORINATED WATER WAS DISCHARGING, WHICH EXCEEDED THE ALLOWED CONCENTRATION , ACCORDING TO THEIR WATER LICENCE. ONCE THE COMMUNITY CONSUMPTION INCREASE ABOVE THE PLANT FLOW, THE RESERVOIRS STARTED TO DROP AND THE DISCHARGE STOPPED. SAMPLES WERE TAKEN NO NOTICEABLE ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACTS TO THE RAINY RIVER. CHLORINE RESIDUAL WAS 2MG/L WHEN DISCHARGE TOOK PLACE. OTHER INFO: CALLER SAYS THAT THEY HAVE GONE BACK TO THEIR DESIGN ENGINEER FOR FURTHER SYSTEM REVIEW AND THEY WILL BE IMPLEMENTING SOME RECOMMENDATIONS TO INCREASE DICHLORINATION EFFICIENCY THROUGHOUT THE WEEKEND. RECOMMENDATIONS: RUNNING CIRCULATION PUMP INTO THE TANK TO RECIRCULATE THE WATER BACK TO THE PUCKS AND HOPEFULLY INCREASE THE CONTACT TIME WITH THE DICHLORINATION PUCKS.

Report Description
****WEB REPORT*****SHIPS FORCE STARTED AND RAN MAIN ENGINES AND GENERATOR ENGINES. AFTER A PERIOD OF TIME WHEN VISIBILITY CLEARED FROM ENGINE SMOKE, SHIPYARD EMPLOYEES NOTICED A DARK LIQUID INSIDE AND OUTSIDE THE OIL BOOM THAT HAD BEEN PLACED AROUND THE SHIP AND A SHEEN UPON THE WATER. SHIPYARD PERSONNEL BEGAN USING OIL SORBENTS TO PICK UP THE MATERIAL. SHIPYARD PERSONNEL BELIEVE THE MATERIAL IS A PRESERVATIVE PLACED IN THE ENGINE BY OTHERS WHILE THE VESSEL WAS BEING REPAIRED.THE SHIPS CAPTAIN STATED HE BELIEVES THIS IS PART OF NORMAL SHIPS OPERATIONS AND NOT A RESULT OF A SPILL OR OTHER NEGLIGENCE.

Report Description/// POTENTIAL RELEASE /// RECEIVED THE BELOW REPORT RELATING TO DUMPING OF SNOWMOBILE PARTS INTO THE RIDEAU CANAL FROM THE STAFF AT CATARAQUI REGION CONSERVATION AUTHORITY. IT SOUNDS LIKE THE MUNICIPAL STAFF DISCOVERED THE SLED PARTS AS OPPOSED TO WITNESSING THE ACTUAL DUMPING ACTIVITY ITSELF. I AM SEEKING CLARIFICATION ON THIS FROM CRCA AND HAVE ASKED FOR SITE PHOTOS, IF AVAILABLE FORWARD ANY NEW INFORMATION AS IT BECOMES AVAILABLE, AND PLEASE LET ME KNOW IF THIS REPORT SHOULD BE SHARED WITH ANYONE ELSE. THE ONTARIO SPILLS ACTION CENTRE IS COPIED ON THIS EMAIL FOR THEIR INFORMATION. IT IS NOT CURRENTLY KNOWN IF THERE WAS A SPILL OF ANY FUEL OR CONTAMINANTS AS A RESULT OF THE PARTS DUMPING. JUST WONDERING IF EITHER YOU HAVE CONTACTS THAT WORK FOR NATIONAL PARKS/RIDEAU CANAL THAT I COULD PASS SOME INFORMATION ON TO? I GOT A REPORT FROM A SOUTH FRONTENAC MUNICIPAL STAFF MEMBER WHO FOUND A BUNCH OF "SNOWMOBILE SKELETONS AND PARTS" (SUSPECTED STOLEN AND STRIPPED) THAT WERE DUMPED OFF A BRIDGE INTO THE CANAL UP NEAR HWY 15 AND SUNBURY RD. I"VE ATTACHED A GOOGLE MAPS SCREEN SHOT OF THE LOCATION. THE REPORT WAS THAT THEYWERE DUMPED OFF THE SOUTH SIDE OF THE BRIDGE. THE CONCERN WAS MORE OF A NAVIGATIONAL ONE FOR BIG BOATS COMING THROUGH THE LOCKS SYSTEM THEN IT WAS AN ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACTS ONE, BUT EITHER WAY I FIGURE SOMEONE WHO"S JURISDICTION IT IS SHOULD BE MADE AWARE OF THE POTENTIAL HAZARD. THIS IS ALL OF THE INFORMATION I WAS GIVEN. APPARENTLY ONE OF THE GUYS TOOK A PHOTO BUT I HAVE NOT RECEIVED IT YET, AND THEY ARE DONE FOR THE DAY NOW, SO UNSURE WHEN IT WILL COME IN.
